chunks: From him, from al-Naḍr, from Yaḥyā al-Ḥalabī, from Dāwūd al-Abzārī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The minimum tasbih is three times while you are in sajdah; do not be hasty in them.

key_terms.أَدْنَى: the minimum or least sufficient amount
key_terms.التَّسْبِيحِ: glorification of Allah in the prescribed remembrance
key_terms.سَاجِدٌ: being in the state of prostration

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum tasbih in sajdah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum amount of tasbih to be said in sajdah as three repetitions. It also instructs the worshipper not to rush while reciting them, indicating the importance of composure in salat.
